about: Every staging build, newest first. The top version always matches package.json. Each entry's checks are what to run on staging before a promote. Live = main's package.json version; staging may be at most 5 builds ahead (scripts/check-release.mjs). Plain words about the change only, never anything a user typed.

releases.title: Test lab on staging
items: 🧪 Test lab on staging: every check for the builds that aren't live yet, oldest first, then the Before you promote checks.
Mark each one ✓ Works or ✗ Broken, add a note, and send a broken one to the 💡 Ideas jar as a 🔥 Now bug.
Re-check walks only the broken ones after a fix; Continue walks only what isn't ✓ yet.
When everything passes it says Ready to promote and copies the promote message for your Claude chat.
Opens from the 🧪 button bottom left (with Show my Ideas tab on) or straight from the staging link ending in #testlab. Never on live. Results are saved on this phone only.

checks.say: Open the staging link ending in #testlab on the iPhone.
checks.see: The Test lab opens on its own and the top line says Live v2.0.0, staging v2.1.3, 5/5 ahead.

checks.say: Tap Start, mark this step ✓ Works, then on the next one tap ✗ Broken and type a short note.
checks.see: The note box shows under the buttons and the 🧪 button bottom left says ✗ 1 broken after you close the panel.

checks.say: Open that broken step again and tap 💡 Add to Ideas jar.
checks.see: It says it's in the Ideas jar as a 🔥 Now bug, and the 💡 Ideas tab lists it.

checks.say: Close and reopen staging, then open the Test lab.
checks.see: Your ✓ and ✗ are still there, and the button says ▶ Re-check 1 fix.
No 🧪 button, even with Show my Ideas tab on.

releases.title: Two-speed tests: quick staging, full suite for promote and live
items: Staging pushes deploy after the release check and a quick core set of 22 smoke tests, instead of the full suite on both versions.
Live is only re-tested on a staging push when main hasn't passed its own full run.
The full suite still runs on every staging push, in the background, and turns the run red if anything fails.
A pull request from staging into main runs the full suite on what goes live (Promote check), and the main deploy runs it again on both versions.

checks.say: Open the newest Test and deploy run for staging in the Actions tab.
checks.see: "Live not re-tested" note, the staging smoke step says (quick), and build plus deploy finish in a few minutes. "Full tests (staging, background)" finishes after and is green.

checks.say: Open staging on the iPhone after that run.

releases.title: Release loop: N/5 limit and the full fix session
items: releases.json lists every staging build with the checks to run before promote.
Each staging deploy checks the list and stops if staging is more than 5 builds ahead of live.
Copy fix session now starts with the release limit check, ends with the N/5 count, and carries the promote steps and the 3-question loop check.

checks.say: Open the latest Test and deploy run on GitHub (Actions tab) and look at the Release check step.
checks.see: A Release limit note like "Staging is 3/5 ahead of live" and "Release check passed."

checks.say: On staging, turn on More options > Show my Ideas tab, log a test idea, then tap Copy fix session and paste it into Notes.
checks.see: It has a Release limit step before any code, a Queued for my jar table rule, releases.json, the Pre-flight passed, promote steps, and a Loop check. Delete the test idea after.

releases.title: Ideas tab, the journey pass, My context, Rework
items: Owner-only Ideas tab: log bugs, ideas and faster ways, Copy fix session, fixes close their own ideas through ideas-done.json.
Experience pass: Speak, Answer, Copy strip, one message style, Copy as the finish line, Quality check at a glance, motion.
My context (dev tools): reusable background picked per prompt.
Screen stays awake while Gemini works, and Rework from this prompt.

checks.say: On the iPhone, open staging fresh and build one prompt in Quick.
checks.see: Speak, Answer, Copy at the top, Answer says Skipped in Quick, and Copy turns into a check when tapped.

checks.say: Turn on More options > Show my Ideas tab, tap the 💡, log a test bug, then Delete it.
checks.see: The idea shows in the list, stays after a reload, and Delete removes it.

checks.say: Show my dev tools on, open My context under Build, add a piece, tap its chip, build a prompt.
checks.see: The prompt points to the piece by its title. Delete the test piece after (asks twice).

checks.say: Build a Normal prompt and don't touch the phone while it works.
checks.see: The screen stays on until the prompt is ready.

releases.title: Staging lane
items: Staging publishes at /speak-to-prompt/staging/ next to live, with a STAGING badge and its own saved data (stg: keys).
Roll back by tag from the Actions tab.

checks.say: Open staging and live side by side.
checks.see: Only staging shows the STAGING badge with its version. A Gemini key saved on staging doesn't show up on live.
